title: NILS pipeline results (results.json)
description: What a pipeline says of its run, written to /output/results.json: v0's schema (one entry per work unit with its status, its files, its metrics and its error) and the proposals. The runner reads it after the container exits. Without it, a unit whose declared outputs are found is taken as succeeded and one whose outputs are missing as failed. A unit the file does not name is failed, a file outside /output is refused, and a proposal is passed to the review spine, never written as a fact.

unit_id.description: The unit as /inputs/manifest.json names it: sub-<s>, sub-<s>_ses-<t> or stack-<id> (sub-<s>/ses-<t> and a bare stack id are read too)

proposals.description: Values the pipeline proposes, each on an axis the descriptor declares; the review spine takes them as a model's evidence (record 43 S6)
